description: Agent-based, network-structured simulation of mask-wearing adoption and persistence under social influence, policy interventions, market constraints, and optional infectious disease transmission. Agents interact across household, workplace/school, and public contexts; adoption decisions combine perceived norms, personal risk, and policy pressures, constrained by mask supply and prices. Disease transmission uses contact-driven SEIR-like dynamics with mask-modulated transmission.

parameters.infection_state: S for all except 'initial_infected' selected at random as I pre-symptomatic
parameters.information_sources: subset of MediaChannel ids sampled by reach

parameters.type_mix: schools for age<school_age_threshold and enrolled; others are workplaces

parameters.message_frequency: uniform 0.5-1.5 per day scaled by campaign_intensity when active

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs social/contact networks, assigns people to households, workplaces/schools, and public places; sets baseline contact rates per context.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day == 0:
  set RNG seed
  create households with sizes ~ distribution(household_size_mean)
  assign persons to households
  create workplaces/schools count ~ population_size/workplace_size_mean
  assign persons to workplaces or schools by age and employment/school rates
  create Watts-Strogatz small-world graph with N=population_size, k=average_degree, beta=rewiring_prob if network_type=='small_world' else alternative
  store graph as graph.social_network
  set per-context contact rates = {home: contact_rate_home, work: contact_rate_work, public: contact_rate_public}
else:
  no-op
notes: Small-world network yields clustering consistent with social influence.
Household cliques can be added by connecting all members fully.

modules.name: MobilityContacts
modules.description: Generates daily contacts by context using schedules and contact rates; outputs contact pairs with context labels.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  determine contexts visited today:
    home always
    work/school with prob=work_attendance_rate if assigned
    public with prob=daily_public_visit_prob
  for each context c in {home, work/school, public} visited:
    draw C_i ~ Poisson(contact_rate_c * gamma(1/cv^2, cv^2)) to add variability
    sample contacts from appropriate pool:
      home: household members
      work/school: workplace peers
      public: random sample from persons in public_places weighted by place occupancy
    create undirected contact edges (i, j, context=c)
collect all contacts into events.daily_contacts
notes: Public contacts are pooled across places to approximate mixing.

modules.name: PolicyAndMedia
modules.description: Activates and enforces mask mandates; runs information campaigns via media channels; updates policy pressure signals.

notes: Policy pressure converts mandate strictness to an individual-level utility term.
Campaign affects risk perception additively with small daily increments.

modules.name: MarketAndSupply
modules.description: Manages mask inventory, prices, and purchases; updates mask ownership and qualities for persons.

update_rule.pseudocode:
estimate demand by quality q from persons lacking mask or replacing due to wear: D_q = sum_i desire(i,q)
for each retailer r:
  for quality q in {cloth, surgical, respirator}:
    sell = min(D_q * r.quality_mix[q] / retailer_count, r.inventory[q])
    r.inventory[q] -= sell
    record sold per quality
    update price: p_new = max(0.5, r.price[q] * (1 + 0.5 * (sold - r.restock_rate*q_target) / max(1, r.inventory[q]+sold)))
for persons i wanting to buy:
  choose quality by expected utility = efficacy/price - cost_sensitivity * price, subject to budget
  if available: i.mask_owned = 1; i.mask_quality = chosen
restock: r.inventory[q] += restock_rate_per_day * max(0, target_stock - r.inventory[q])
notes: Price update is a simple proportional rule driven by imbalance between demand and supply.
Demand is constrained by per-person budgets and price elasticity.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceAndAdoption
modules.description: Updates attitudes and risk perceptions via social influence and campaigns; decides mask use by context considering policy pressure and supply; applies fatigue and forgetting.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  observe neighbors' mask use in recent contacts: norm_hat = mean(mask_use_public of neighbors) + Normal(0, norm_observation_noise)
  perceived_social_norm_i = clamp((1 - forgetting_rate)*perceived_social_norm_i + forgetting_rate*norm_hat, 0, 1)
  attitude_i = clamp((1 - forgetting_rate)*attitude_i + social_influence_weight*perceived_social_norm_i + personal_risk_weight*risk_perception_i + policy_weight*signal.policy_pressure_by_person[i] - fatigue_rate*fatigue_level_i, 0, 1)
  propensity_base = 0.5*attitude_i + 0.5*compliance_propensity_i
  for context c in {home, work, public}:
    context_bias = context_bias_home if c==home else (context_bias_work if c==work else context_bias_public)
    policy_term = signal.policy_pressure_by_person[i] * (1 if c!=home else 0)
    supply_term = 0.15 if mask_owned_i else -0.15
    cost_term = -cost_sensitivity * expected_price_for_person_i
    p_wear = sigmoid( -1.5 + 2.0*propensity_base + context_bias + policy_term + supply_term + cost_term )
    set current_mask_use_c ~ Bernoulli(p_wear)
  update fatigue: fatigue_level_i = clamp(fatigue_level_i + policy_fatigue_increment*(current_mask_use_public?1:0), 0, 1)
  update risk perception by media already applied; also adjust: risk_perception_i = clamp(risk_perception_i * (1 - forgetting_rate) + 0.01 * recent_local_incidence, 0, 1)
notes: Recent local incidence can be approximated by fraction of infected neighbors.
Decision uses a logistic function combining attitude, policy, supply, and cost.

modules.name: DiseaseTransmission
modules.description: Optional SEIR-like transmission on daily contacts; computes infection events and counterfactual no-mask infections using same contacts; updates states.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if not enable_disease: return
new_inf = 0; new_inf_no_mask = 0
for each contact (i,j,context) in events.daily_contacts:
  for ordered pair (src,dst) in [(i,j),(j,i)]:
    if src is infectious and dst is susceptible:
      base_p = transmission_rate
      eff_out = mask_efficacy_outward * quality_multiplier(mask_quality_src) if src wears in context else 0
      eff_in = mask_efficacy_inward * quality_multiplier(mask_quality_dst) if dst wears in context else 0
      p = base_p * (1 - eff_out) * (1 - eff_in)
      infect_event ~ Bernoulli(p)
      infect_event_no_mask ~ Bernoulli(base_p)
      if infect_event: mark dst as exposed (E); new_inf += 1
      if infect_event_no_mask: new_inf_no_mask += 1
progress states using durations:
  E -> I with rate 1/incubation_period_mean
  I -> R with rate 1/infectious_period_mean
collect daily counts observable.new_infections = new_inf; observable.new_infections_no_mask = new_inf_no_mask
notes: Counterfactual no-mask uses same contacts and base transmission to estimate infections averted.
Infectiousness can be refined by day-since-infection weighting if desired.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and computes Rt and disparities.

update_rule.pseudocode:
overall_public = mean(Person.current_mask_use_public)
workplace_rate = mean(Person.current_mask_use_work for employed/school attendees)
mandate_rate = mean(1 if (mandate_active and current_mask_use_public) or (not mandate_active) else 0)
avg_quality = weighted_mean(quality_to_score(mask_quality) over persons wearing masks in any context)
by_SES = group_mean(current_mask_use_public by SES quintile); disparity = by_SES[q5] - by_SES[q1]
compute Rt using renewal: Rt_t = new_infections_t / sum_{k} new_infections_{t-k} * w_k where w is discretized gamma(mean=generation_interval_mean, sd=generation_interval_sd)
update cumulative infections series with new_infections and counterfactual
emit all observables
notes: Rt estimation uses a simple renewal equation with a 7-day smoothing window.

observables.formula_or_field: fraction of persons complying when mandate_active
weighted average of quality scores among mask wearers
count of new infections per day
counterfactual new infections per day with no mask effect
renewal equation estimate from new_infections and generation interval

algorithms.WattsStrogatzSmallWorld: Generates a small-world graph with high clustering and short path lengths.
algorithms.ContactGenerationWithOverdispersion: Poisson-gamma mixture to generate overdispersed daily contacts per context.
algorithms.SocialNormBayesianUpdate: Exponential smoothing of perceived norms with observation noise.
algorithms.LogisticMaskDecision: Sigmoid function combining attitude, policy, supply, and cost to produce wear probability by context.
algorithms.SupplyDemandPriceAdjustment: Proportional inventory imbalance rule to adjust retail prices.
algorithms.SEIR_ContactDriven: Discrete-time SEIR transitions triggered by contact-level infection trials.
algorithms.RenewalRtEstimation: Rt computed from incidence and generation interval via renewal equation with smoothing.
